subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access (gated by NDA) - onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@capstonebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access (gated by NDA) - onboarding checklist

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per Capstone's procurement policy, you indicated you need the full SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter for our 2025 audit window, but that access needs to be gated by an NDA before we can share the unredacted PDF.

Next steps I propose: 
- I can share a redacted PDF today for your initial review (no system-level details).
- We'll route our standard NDA (attached) for countersignature. Once we have the countersigned NDA we will deliver the full Type II + bridge letter via a secure SharePoint link and a short call to walk through any controls questions.

Can you confirm the legal contact who will countersign? Also confirm whether Capstone requires evidence exports (logs) or just the Type II report and bridge letter at this stage.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf, NDA_Redwood_v1_draft.pdf (attachment stubs)

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access (gated by NDA) - onboarding checklist

Avery —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Our procurement/legal team will need to countersign the NDA. Please loop in your legal contact if you want direct redlines — otherwise we can accept your standard form and have our counsel countersign.

Legal contact (countersign): Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@capstonebank.com>
We only need the full Type II and bridge letter for now; evidence exports (logs) are not required unless we get to an in-depth security review later.

If you can send the redacted PDF now, that will let our InfoSec folks start the preliminary review while legal handles the NDA.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Vendor Risk
Capstone Bank

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for confirming. I started the DocuSign envelope (DocuSign:ABCDEF-123456) using Redwood's standard NDA. Elena, you should receive an email with a request to review and sign — please use the "Sign as Organization" option if you have a corporate signature block.

Once signed we will: 
1) Swap the redacted file for the full Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf at the secure link (one-week SAS link).
2) Upload our short bridge letter summarizing the audited period (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) and scope.
3) Offer a 30-minute walkthrough call to answer any control-specific questions (optional).

For tracking: I will paste the DocuSign envelope ID and the final SharePoint link in this thread when completed.

Attachments: NDA_Redwood_v1_signed.pdf (will be uploaded once countersigned)
